verdict.rationale:
Working Copy documents automation surfaces such as Shortcuts integration, a built-in WebDAV server, and Files-app/document-picker access that let other apps or workflows drive it programmatically, and it even has an in-app conversational 'Repository Agent' for AI-driven git operations. However, there is no evidence of a conventional documented public API (REST/OpenAPI, CLI, or llms.txt) — probes explicitly show 404s for llms.txt, markdown docs, and all openapi/swagger endpoints, indicating no formal API spec for external AI agents to call.

missing for 10: a REST/OpenAPI or CLI-style documented API, machine-readable API docs (llms.txt/openapi.json all 404), and independent confirmation that Shortcuts/WebDAV surfaces are sufficient for full agentic control.
